records.name: MENA Inflation & Price Measurement Observatory
records.purpose: Measure and compare official price evidence across MENA while preserving basket definitions, base changes, monthly versus annual dynamics, release timing, revisions and structural breaks.

records.name: MENA Labour Market Comparability Project
records.purpose: Audit the population perimeter, age framework, nationality treatment, denominator and classification architecture behind headline labour-market indicators.

records.name: Firm AI Adoption & Labour Adjustment
records.purpose: Separate corporate AI language from verifiable operational adoption and measure how documented adoption relates to employment, workforce composition and labour adjustment.

records.name: Official Statistics Revision & Vintage Archive
records.purpose: Preserve first releases, later revisions and methodological breaks so researchers can reconstruct what an official series looked like at a historical date.

records.name: MENA Funding & Procurement Intelligence
records.purpose: Normalize official procurement, award and development-finance records into auditable buyer, opportunity and supplier intelligence.

records.name: MENA Economic Release Calendar
records.purpose: Track verified official economic release dates and, where directly supplied, publication times without inferring dates or times from secondary sources.

records.name: MENA Evidence Lineage Project
records.purpose: Make claims auditable from source through observation and transformation to published conclusion, retaining language, vintage, retrieval time, file identity and validation state.

cross_program_infrastructure.name: MENA Evidence Terminal
cross_program_infrastructure.role: Machine-readable provenance backbone across all research programmes.
